why: A self-reference looks back at the field's own earlier value (L747-749), here at its fixed-up path; the fallback to the original path is for an included file that "might intend to refer to the application's root config" (L1043-1047), which a field referring to itself does not. typesafe/config reads it so: a += 2 included at k is k.a = ${?k.a} [2], k.a has no earlier value, and the root's unrelated a = [1] is not looked at: k.a is [2].
